title: Final Merit-List of Undergraduate Students For Admissions Fall-2025
text:
Final Merit-List and Provisionally Admitted Students

We are pleased to announce that the
final merit list for admission to AWKUM for Fall 2025 Semester

has been finalized and is now available on the admission portal.

Selected students are required to
pay their dues online
by clicking the button below.
The
last date to pay dues is 11.09.2025
.
Please note that all admissions are provisional, and verification of documents and marksheets will be
completed after payment.

This is the
final merit list
. After
11.09.2025
, admissions will be offered on a
first-come, first-served
basis, subject to the availability of seats.

Pay Dues Online (https://admissions.awkum.edu.pk/)

Important Notice for Students

Your admission will be
cancelled
if any of your submitted documents are found to be fake or incorrect.

If you find any mistake or error in your record, please contact the
Directorate of Admissions and Financial Aid (FAD)
immediately.

Final Merit List Click to Download (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xJm-8RvVL5E1KVQzzj9pmBiR9dRQ416A/view?usp=drive_link)
